sampling.alloc: PRE after valley XML / before trim branch; POST after trim+posttrim XML, before valley sleep; same phase for none; measurement handshake outside trim timing
sampling.gst: existing RELEASE_READY/PRE_CAPTURED and RELEASE_DONE/POST_CAPTURED; all 51 cycles
sampling.g4: malloc_info first, then pre capture, one gdb malloc_trim(0), post capture; no restart or UI stimulus; >=120.000 s between injections; faults in ensuing 120 s idle window
sampling.next_cycle_faults: G1/G2 next rise, G3 next CYCLE_METRIC, last cycle NA; G4 separate 120 s daemon window (not a cycle)
sampling.memps: retain full original output and PID, compare RSS/heap Private_Dirty labels as independent observation, not identical classifier assumption
sampling.units: proc kB interpreted as KiB; MiB=KiB/1024; decimal MB=KiB*1024/1000000; retain both, never label MiB as MB

derivation.heap_drop: pre glibc heap PD - post glibc heap PD; pct=100*drop/pre
derivation.memavailable_net: trim delta - none delta, paired by group/rep/cycle; matched phase NOT simultaneous global-time control; G4 NA
derivation.summary: median and max-min over the three cycle-1 repetitions of each group/arm, preserve signed deltas; all other cycles retained separately
derivation.business: reuse gst nearest-rank implementation, cycles 2..51; p99 direction REPORT_ONLY, do not promise no cost

availability.governors_before: all four schedutil; otherwise occupied/unknown STOP
availability.foreign_work: any alloc_bench/gst_loop_decode/gst-launch/gdb/sampler process, nonempty glibc_memopt directory, other established sdb client, or observed foreground test workload => occupied/unknown STOP; no exclusive ownership inferred from IP
availability.gdb: existing compatible gdb or exact six-package B2 official snapshot install if absent and budget permits; record ownership; uninstall only this-round additions

health.majflt_zero_windows: all pre/post captures, alloc rise/reactivation, gst warm cycles 2..51 and next-cycle costs, G4 120 s idle; gst cold cycle 1 faults retained/report-only as existing contract
health.attributable_new_alert: STOP, archive then clean attributable files only; no injection waiver
health.known_alerts: existing S4 A cpu.relative waiver is registered but NOT APPLICABLE to this B-cycle/G3/G4 matrix
health.incomplete_or_inconsistent_cell: STOP all later stages, no repeat for favorable numbers
health.cleanup: restore all four governors schedutil, verify no own process/workdir/package/archive residue; never delete other users' artifacts

claim_boundary: 测试板合成/官方工具负载量级，不等于产品收益；G4 常驻同一 PID 三次非独立重启；采样握手增加相位间观测间隙，不计入 trim 调用或 gst 业务计时。
